import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func probeClock() time.Time {
	return time.Date(2026, 5, 23, 12, 34, 56, 0, time.FixedZone("UTC+5", 5*3600))
}

func probeSHA(s string) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(s))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

type probeScenario struct {
	name string
	run  func(t *testing.T, root string) string
}

func probeStubbed(root string, calls *[]string, refuse string, shipRC int, verifyErr error) Inputs {
	return Inputs{
		Cycle:       42,
		Workspace:   filepath.Join(root, "ws"),
		ProjectRoot: root,
		Token:       "tok-42",
		Now:         probeClock,
		AdvanceFn: func(phase, agent string) error {
			*calls = append(*calls, "advance "+phase+" "+agent)
			if phase == refuse {
				return errors.New("refused")
			}
			return nil
		},
		ShipDryRunFn: func(msg string) (int, error) {
			*calls = append(*calls, "ship "+msg)
			return shipRC, errors.New("ship error is discarded")
		},
		VerifyFn: func() error {
			*calls = append(*calls, "verify")
			return verifyErr
		},
	}
}

func probeRun(in Inputs, calls *[]string) string {
	var stderr strings.Builder
	rc := Run(in, &stderr)
	return fmt.Sprintf("rc=%d\ncalls:\n%s\nstderr:\n%s", rc, strings.Join(*calls, "\n"), stderr.String())
}

func probeStubbedRun(refuse string, shipRC int, verifyErr error, prepare func(t *testing.T, root string)) func(t *testing.T, root string) string {
	return func(t *testing.T, root string) string {
		if prepare != nil {
			prepare(t, root)
		}
		var calls []string
		return probeRun(probeStubbed(root, &calls, refuse, shipRC, verifyErr), &calls)
	}
}

func probeMkdir(rel string) func(t *testing.T, root string) {
	return func(t *testing.T, root string) {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, rel), 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}

func probeWrite(t *testing.T, path, body string, mode os.FileMode) {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), mode); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func probeScripts(t *testing.T, pluginRoot, logPath string) {
	script := func(name, extra string) string {
		return "#!/bin/bash\necho \"" + name + " $*\" >> \"" + logPath + "\"\n" + extra
	}
	probeWrite(t, filepath.Join(pluginRoot, "legacy", "scripts", "lifecycle", "cycle-state.sh"), script("cycle-state", "if [ \"$2\" = \"$PROBE_REFUSE\" ]; then exit 1; fi\nexit 0\n"), 0o755)
	probeWrite(t, filepath.Join(pluginRoot, "legacy", "scripts", "lifecycle", "ship.sh"), script("ship", "exit 4\n"), 0o755)
	probeWrite(t, filepath.Join(pluginRoot, "legacy", "scripts", "observability", "verify-ledger-chain.sh"), script("verify", "exit 1\n"), 0o755)
}

func probeDefaults(pluginRootRel, refuse string) func(t *testing.T, root string) string {
	return func(t *testing.T, root string) string {
		if _, err := exec.LookPath("bash"); err != nil {
			return "skipped: no bash\n"
		}
		pluginRoot := filepath.Join(root, pluginRootRel)
		probeScripts(t, pluginRoot, filepath.Join(root, "calls.log"))
		t.Setenv("PROBE_REFUSE", refuse)
		in := Inputs{Cycle: 7, Workspace: filepath.Join(root, "ws"), ProjectRoot: root}
		if pluginRootRel != "" {
			in.PluginRoot = pluginRoot
		}
		var stderr strings.Builder
		rc := Run(in, &stderr)
		return fmt.Sprintf("rc=%d\nstderr:\n%s", rc, stderr.String())
	}
}

func probeValidation(t *testing.T, root string) string {
	ws := filepath.Join(root, "ws")
	cases := []Inputs{
		{Cycle: 0, Workspace: ws, ProjectRoot: root},
		{Cycle: -3, Workspace: ws, ProjectRoot: root},
		{Cycle: 1, ProjectRoot: root},
		{Cycle: 1, Workspace: ws},
	}
	var b strings.Builder
	for i, in := range cases {
		var stderr strings.Builder
		rc := Run(in, &stderr)
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "case %d rc=%d stderr=%q\n", i, rc, stderr.String())
	}
	return b.String()
}

func probeRetroLedgerUnreadable(t *testing.T, root string) string {
	if os.Geteuid() == 0 {
		return "skipped: root ignores file modes\n"
	}
	var calls []string
	in := probeStubbed(root, &calls, "", 0, nil)
	ledger := filepath.Join(root, ".evolve", "ledger.jsonl")
	in.ShipDryRunFn = func(msg string) (int, error) {
		calls = append(calls, "ship "+msg)
		return 0, os.Chmod(ledger, 0o000)
	}
	out := probeRun(in, &calls)
	if err := os.Chmod(ledger, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return out
}

func probeRunIDStamped(t *testing.T, root string) string {
	ws := filepath.Join(root, ".evolve", "runs", "cycle-42")
	probeWrite(t, filepath.Join(ws, "run.json"), `{"cycle_id":42,"run_id":"01PROBERUNID0000000000000"}`, 0o644)
	var calls []string
	in := probeStubbed(root, &calls, "", 0, nil)
	in.Workspace = ws
	return probeRun(in, &calls)
}

func probeExistingLedger(t *testing.T, root string) string {
	probeWrite(t, filepath.Join(root, ".evolve", "ledger.jsonl"), "{\"seed\":1}\n{\"seed\":2}\n", 0o644)
	var calls []string
	return probeRun(probeStubbed(root, &calls, "", 0, nil), &calls)
}

func probeAppend(t *testing.T, root string) string {
	ledger := filepath.Join(root, ".evolve", "ledger.jsonl")
	artifact := filepath.Join(root, "art", "scout-report.md")
	probeWrite(t, artifact, "scout body\n", 0o644)
	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "missing artifact: %v\n", appendSimLedger(ledger, 7, "scout", filepath.Join(root, "absent.md"), "tok-a", root, probeClock))
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "present artifact: %v\n", appendSimLedger(ledger, 7, "builder", artifact, "tok-b", root, probeClock))
	return b.String()
}

func probeAppendTipBlocked(t *testing.T, root string) string {
	probeMkdir(filepath.Join(".evolve", "ledger.tip.tmp"))(t, root)
	artifact := filepath.Join(root, "a.md")
	probeWrite(t, artifact, "a\n", 0o644)
	err := appendSimLedger(filepath.Join(root, ".evolve", "ledger.jsonl"), 3, "auditor", artifact, "tok", root, probeClock)
	return fmt.Sprintf("err=%v\n", err != nil)
}

func probeGit(t *testing.T, dir string, args ...string) string {
	cmd := exec.Command("git", append([]string{"-C", dir, "-c", "user.name=probe", "-c", "user.email=probe@example.com", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null"}, args...)...)
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("git %v: %v\n%s", args, err, out)
	}
	return strings.TrimRight(string(out), "\n")
}

func probeAppendInGitRepo(t *testing.T, root string) string {
	if _, err := exec.LookPath("git"); err != nil {
		return "skipped: no git\n"
	}
	repo := filepath.Join(root, "repo")
	probeWrite(t, filepath.Join(repo, "tracked.txt"), "one\n", 0o644)
	probeGit(t, repo, "init", "-q")
	probeGit(t, repo, "add", "tracked.txt")
	probeGit(t, repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", "seed")
	probeWrite(t, filepath.Join(repo, "tracked.txt"), "one\ntwo\n", 0o644)
	probeGit(t, repo, "add", "tracked.txt")
	head := probeGit(t, repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
	diff := probeGit(t, repo, "diff", "HEAD")
	artifact := filepath.Join(root, "b.md")
	probeWrite(t, artifact, "b\n", 0o644)
	ledger := filepath.Join(root, ".evolve", "ledger.jsonl")
	err := appendSimLedger(ledger, 5, "builder", artifact, "tok-git", repo, probeClock)
	body, rerr := os.ReadFile(ledger)
	if rerr != nil {
		return fmt.Sprintf("err=%v read=%v\n", err, rerr)
	}
	line := strings.ReplaceAll(string(body), head, "<HEAD>")
	line = strings.ReplaceAll(line, probeSHA(diff), "<SHA(diff HEAD)>")
	for _, dir := range []string{repo, filepath.Join(root, ".evolve")} {
		if err := os.RemoveAll(dir); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("err=%v\nledger=%s", err, line)
}

func probeScenarios() []probeScenario {
	var scenarios []probeScenario
	scenarios = append(scenarios,
		probeScenario{"validation", probeValidation},
		probeScenario{"full-ship-nonzero-verify-warn", probeStubbedRun("", 3, errors.New("anomaly"), nil)},
		probeScenario{"full-clean", probeStubbedRun("", 0, nil, nil)},
	)
	for _, phase := range []string{"intent", "research", "build", "audit", "ship", "retrospective"} {
		scenarios = append(scenarios, probeScenario{"refuse-" + phase, probeStubbedRun(phase, 0, nil, nil)})
	}
	scenarios = append(scenarios,
		probeScenario{"workspace-is-file", probeStubbedRun("", 0, nil, func(t *testing.T, root string) { probeWrite(t, filepath.Join(root, "ws"), "x", 0o644) })},
		probeScenario{"intent-write-fails", probeStubbedRun("", 0, nil, probeMkdir(filepath.Join("ws", "intent.md")))},
		probeScenario{"audit-write-fails", probeStubbedRun("", 0, nil, probeMkdir(filepath.Join("ws", "audit-report.md")))},
		probeScenario{"retro-write-fails", probeStubbedRun("", 0, nil, probeMkdir(filepath.Join("ws", "retrospective-report.md")))},
		probeScenario{"report-write-fails", probeStubbedRun("", 0, nil, probeMkdir(filepath.Join("ws", "simulator-report.md")))},
		probeScenario{"ledger-dir-is-file", probeStubbedRun("", 0, nil, func(t *testing.T, root string) { probeWrite(t, filepath.Join(root, ".evolve"), "x", 0o644) })},
		probeScenario{"retro-ledger-unreadable", probeRetroLedgerUnreadable},
		probeScenario{"run-id-stamped", probeRunIDStamped},
		probeScenario{"existing-ledger", probeExistingLedger},
		probeScenario{"default-seams", probeDefaults("", "none")},
		probeScenario{"default-seams-refuse-build", probeDefaults("", "build")},
		probeScenario{"explicit-plugin-root", probeDefaults("plugin", "none")},
		probeScenario{"append-direct", probeAppend},
		probeScenario{"append-tip-blocked", probeAppendTipBlocked},
		probeScenario{"append-in-git-repo", probeAppendInGitRepo},
	)
	return scenarios
}

var probeTSPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`"ts":"([^"]+)"`)

func probeNormalizeLedger(raw string) string {
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(raw, "\n"), "\n")
	out := make([]string, len(lines))
	for i, line := range lines {
		norm := line
		if i > 0 {
			norm = strings.ReplaceAll(norm, `"prev_hash":"`+probeSHA(lines[i-1])+`"`, `"prev_hash":"<SHA(prev line)>"`)
		}
		var entry struct {
			ArtifactPath string `json:"artifact_path"`
			ArtifactSHA  string `json:"artifact_sha256"`
		}
		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry) == nil && entry.ArtifactSHA != "" {
			if data, err := os.ReadFile(entry.ArtifactPath); err == nil && probeSHA(string(data)) == entry.ArtifactSHA {
				norm = strings.ReplaceAll(norm, entry.ArtifactSHA, "<SHA(artifact)>")
			}
		}
		out[i] = norm
	}
	return strings.Join(out, "\n") + "\n"
}

func probeNormalizeTip(tip, ledger string) string {
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(ledger, "\n"), "\n")
	return strings.ReplaceAll(tip, probeSHA(lines[len(lines)-1]), "<SHA(last line)>")
}

func probeDumpTree(t *testing.T, root string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	ledgerRaw, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, ".evolve", "ledger.jsonl"))
	err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, path)
		if d.IsDir() {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "dir %s\n", rel)
			return nil
		}
		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "file %s unreadable\n", rel)
			return nil
		}
		body := string(data)
		switch d.Name() {
		case "ledger.jsonl":
			body = probeNormalizeLedger(body)
		case "ledger.tip":
			body = probeNormalizeTip(body, string(ledgerRaw))
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "file %s\n%s\n", rel, body)
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return b.String()
}

func probeNormalize(s, root string) string {
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, root, "<ROOT>")
	s = regexp.MustCompile(`(sim-token-\d+)-`+fmt.Sprint(os.Getpid())+`\b`).ReplaceAllString(s, "$1-<PID>")
	return probeTSPattern.ReplaceAllStringFunc(s, func(m string) string {
		ts, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z", probeTSPattern.FindStringSubmatch(m)[1])
		if err == nil && time.Since(ts).Abs() < 2*time.Hour {
			return `"ts":"<RECENT>"`
		}
		return m
	})
}

func TestACS1745Probe(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("ACS1745_PROBE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("runs only under the cycle1745 differential predicate")
	}
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, sc := range probeScenarios() {
		root := t.TempDir()
		text := sc.run(t, root) + probeDumpTree(t, root)
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "== %s ==\n%s", sc.name, probeNormalize(text, root))
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, []byte(b.String()), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
